name: holmes_qa
description: 30 factual questions on The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes (wb.datasets.load_holmes()), written for the workbook (chapter B4): a short answer, its aliases, and the evidence, a short excerpt of the text that contains the answer, located by character positions in the loaded text (start, end). 10 questions are paraphrased: none of their keywords appears within 140 words of their evidence. Plus 5 questions without an answer in the stories (absent, false premise), kept out of the 30.
license: questions, answers and annotations written for the workbook (CC0); the stories are in the public domain (Project Gutenberg eBook 1661)

questions.question: What was Godfrey Norton's profession?

questions.question: What business does Jabez Wilson keep at Coburg Square?

questions.question: In which newspaper did Jabez Wilson find the advertisement of the Red-Headed League?
